svg.aria-label: M-S-STALL seed 13, model-enabled, step by step: Normal operation, one slow task at 1641, the stall from 1800, RCT shown as DK at 1881, the quiet build-up, the release at 2100, the catch-up and the recovery.
svg.text: M-S-STALL, seed 13, model-enabled: what happens, step by step
Your run through the live page (rules first, qwen3:8b when a rule is insufficient). Numbers are DK-RMM's readings in results/live/dkrmm/api-6-8.json: each counts a 60-tick window, one every 20 ticks.
The fault: from tick 1800 the bus delivers nothing (every message held, none dropped); at 2100 everything held is delivered in one tick.
Agents talk on the bus and every message
arrives on time: 74 to 347 messages per
window. Robots take parcels from intake
through sorting to the vans; 1 to 12 tasks
finished per window, 2 to 9 parcels in the
Of the 8 tasks started in the window, one
waited 47 ticks for a robot; the others
waited 1 to 8. The usual worst wait is 8.
severity 4.53, the largest of the run.
The bus holds every message. Agents keep
asking, hear nothing, then wait: messages per
questions time out after 30 ticks and are
asked again (9 retries per window). Robots
finish the errands in hand and stand idle: 4
Four kinds of evidence at once: retry,
already at 1861, 50% of the acting agents
UNSTABLE at 1861, RCT at 1881. Its precursor
is the dragon-king test, which still holds on
include 1641), so the page writes DK.
Messages pile up on the bus: 62 held at 1881,
189 at 2081, 200 at the release. Parcels keep
arriving and nothing leaves: intake 2 to 7,
Little happens, so the readings drift back to
STABLE: a silent facility looks calm.
All 200 held messages arrive in one tick,
every one late. Every agent acts on five
minutes of answers, questions and commands
DEVIATING (nothing held over from the quiet
Tasks that waited through the stall finally
busy from 2161 to 2261; blocked robots 8 to
32 per window; the policy gate refuses 4 to
peak), UNSTABLE. Below 4.53, so not a
Blocks and refusals fall, backlog 15 to 9,
waits back to 8 by 2461. At 3241: backlog 6;
the page showed 81 dispatched and 3 parcels
RCT at 2441 by critical slowing down (the
test no longer holds), STABLE from 2501,
step 2's reading is what the test at step 4 is about
DK at 1881 = an RCT (step 4, made by the stall) while the dragon-king test holds (on step 2, a Normal reading from before the stall).
The stall's own extreme (steps 6 and 7) is smaller than step 2's, so in this run the release is not a dragon-king; the facility recovers (step 8).
